notes: GAAP. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balance (p6). Property tax 2,808,504 split with General Fund schedule B-2 (p14: property tax 2,280,090, homestead 151,669, property tax credit 120,942, interest on delinquent taxes 6,359) plus GO Debt Service property taxes 249,444 (p25); Occupation tax 661,567 split into the four B-2 occupation tax lines; Intergovernmental 5,087,077 split into the B-2, C-2, C-4, E-4, F-3 and G-3 intergovernmental lines (all pieces add exactly). Other financing = sale of capital assets 229,568 + insurance and settlement recoveries 1,591,086; no bond issuance in FY2022. Roll-forward 13,218,176 + 18,192,328 - 17,152,338 + 1,464,361 - 1,464,361 + 1,820,654 = 16,078,820. Cash: governmental funds Balance Sheet (p4) cash and cash equivalents 13,632,147 (2021 column 11,036,297 as beginning); investments separate; county treasurer cash (104,308) not included in cash fields, as in FY2023. Business-type: proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Fund Net Position, enterprise Total column (p9; internal service fund excluded); 43,715,208 + 29,198,786 - 24,937,476 + capital contributions 179,095 = 48,155,613; net loss on disposal (7,889) recorded as a disbursement (disbursement total = Statement of Activities business-type expenses 24,937,476, p3). Balance sheet: government-wide Statement of Net Position (pp1-2), component units excluded. Detail: General Fund from B-2 (pp14-17) and Streets from C-2 (pp18-19) instead of the A-1/A-2 summaries (not recorded); Public Safety Capital Improvements C-4; nonmajor funds from their own budget schedules E-3 to E-6, F-3, F-4, G-3 (these add exactly to the Other Governmental Funds column); utility detail from the Electric, Water and Water Pollution Control enterprise budget schedules H-2, H-5, H-8 (BASWA and Sanitation have no schedule in the trim, so no detail for them). Budget lines with no actual amount are not recorded. Electric/Water/WPC cash flow schedules (H-3, H-6, H-9) not recorded separately (fund-level duplicates of p10). Pages 34-36 are statistical tables.
